newsitem.title: HONG KONG: AWT Transport in HK$100 mln rights issue.
newsitem.headline: AWT Transport in HK$100 mln rights issue.

text.p: AWT World Transport Holdings Ltd said on Monday it plans to issue at least 150 million new shares to raise about HK$100 million after expenses through a proposed one-for-two rights issue at HK$0.70 per share.

The subscription price represented a discount of 13.58 percent of the shares' closing price of HK$0.81 on Friday, the international air and sea freight forwarding services provider said in a statement.
Shares of the company dropped HK$0.08, or 9.9 percent to HK$0.73 in early Monday trade following the announcement.

The company said it would use about HK$40 million of the proceeds to repay existing borrowings and HK$30 million for establishing new branches and joint ventures in southeast Asia such as Taiwan and Vietnam, with the remaining balance going to general corporate purposes.
Applications had been made to the relevant authorities to set up representative offices in Taiwan and Vietnam, it said.
The register of members of the company will be closed from February 17 to 21, both days inclusive, for the purpose of determining entitlements to the rights issue, it added.
